technical_and_design_decisions: Leverage Spring Data abstractions to build a custom repository backing integrated with Kafka changelog topics for local off-heap state management.
Implement an event-driven flush manager that coordinates Kafka consumer offset commits and state store flushes upon receiving producer message acknowledgements.
Utilize Eclipse Californium as the underlying CoAP client library to build a Spring Integration / Spring Cloud Stream CoAP inbound source adapter.
Implement Kerberos security configuration and keytab ticket renewal mechanisms for Sqoop jobs executing against secure HDFS clusters.
Design a Java REST client using Jackson DTOs and Spring RestTemplate/WebClient to interface with Cloud Foundry Diego Receptor API endpoints (Tasks, Desired LRPs, Actual LRPs).
Refactor Boot-based ModuleRunner deployment property resolution to bind module properties directly in containerized environments without legacy xd-containers.
assumptions: Target environment runs on Java 17+ as specified for Spring Framework 6.0+.
Embedded Kafka and Mock CoAP/Hadoop/Diego test environments or containers are available for integration testing.
Developer is responsible for end-to-end implementation, unit testing, integration testing, and documentation.

activities.activity_name: Kafka Changelog Spring Data Repository Integration (U1)
activities.activity_description: Design and implement custom Spring Data repository support backed by Kafka changelog state store to enable off-heap local data affinity for stateful stream processing.

activities.activity_name: Intelligent Offset and State Flush Support (U2, U3)
activities.activity_description: Implement acknowledgment-driven flushing logic for consumer offsets and local state, triggering flushes only upon successful message acknowledgements from the module producer.
Develop a CoAP source module using Eclipse Californium to enable data consumption over CoAP for embedded and bandwidth-constrained devices.
Author user documentation for configuring application property files as deployment manifests.

activities.activity_name: Secured HDFS Cluster Support for Sqoop Jobs (U6)
activities.activity_description: Add Kerberos authentication configuration and security credential management so Sqoop jobs can securely access protected HDFS clusters.
Develop Java receptor REST client library to interact with Cloud Foundry Diego API endpoints (LRPs, Tasks, Cells).
Complete remaining deployment properties resolution and mapping in Boot-based ModuleRunner for container-managed deployment without xd-containers.

activities.activity_name: Integration Testing and Code Review Preparation
activities.activity_description: Perform end-to-end integration testing across modules, verify build pipelines, and finalize user documentation.
